newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France gives new repo tender expiry dates.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France gives new repo tender expiry dates.

text.p: The Bank of France said it was modifying the maturation dates for several repurchase tenders because of national holidays on November 1 and November 11.
Securities at today's October 24 tender, allocating money market funds for tomorrow, will mature on November 5, the Bank said in a statement.

The October 28 tender for next-day funds will mature on November 8, it said. The November 4 tender for November 5 will mature on November 15. The November 7 tender, also for the next day, will mature on November 19.
Securities at the twice-weekly repurchase tender usually mature after eight days.
